findings.text: the re-age assertion advances the reading 800 s to 1145 s, past both the 900 s document bound and the 300 s flight bound, so it passes on a source-blind re-age and guards nothing the node claims; a delta landing between the bounds (100 s, 445 s total, which I verified reads expired False) is the case that would redden on that regression.

compose_document emits no suggested_shelf_life_seconds, so _document_shelf_life_seconds returns None for the real paid-lanes document and the document's-own-shelf half of the new rule fires only on the test's synthetic document, leaving the flight-shelf fallback as that branch's only production effect.
the gate log holds only a progress line and a count, with no revision, tree or command header and no EXIT= sentinel, so a reader cannot tell which revision produced the 8 passed the manifest cites.
